description: This Java class named GenreStatistics extends the Statistics class and provides functionality to analyze book genres within a book-tracking application. It computes statistics such as the most read genre, the most liked genre based on ratings, and the least liked genre, by processing books from a shelf service and filtering books with genres and ratings.

classes.name: GenreStatistics
classes.description: Provides statistical analysis specific to genres within a book collection, including most read, most liked, and least liked genres.

methods.name: findMostReadGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre that has been read the highest number of times.

methods.name: findMostLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the highest total rating sum across all read books.

methods.name: findLeastLikedGenre
methods.description: Returns the genre with the lowest total rating sum across all read books.
